info.name: Task Tracker API
info.description:
REST API of the Unified Team Task & Support Ticket Tracker. All paths are under `/api`.

**Run it:** import this collection and `local.postman_environment.json`, select the environment, start the app with seeded data (`pnpm dev` after `pnpm run setup`, or Docker), then run the whole collection with the Collection Runner. Folders depend on the ids saved by earlier folders, so run them in order.

Every request sets its own `Authorization: Bearer {{token<Role>}}`, so it is clear which role is calling. Responses use `{ success: true, data, meta? }` or `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details? } }`.

Real-time notifications (Socket.IO events `notification:new`, `notification:count`, `notification:updated`) cannot be shown in Postman; see them in the web app or in `apps/server/tests/socket.test.ts`.
